plugin.name: Client
plugin.description: Choose this on a PC joining somebody else's Skyrim Together server. No INI editing or port forwarding is required. IEDSyncTogether automatically reuses the STR server address and STR server password after you connect in Skyrim Together.

plugin.name: Host
plugin.description: Choose this on the PC hosting the Skyrim Together server and the forwarded IEDSyncTogether UDP port 38471. IEDSyncTogether automatically reads the STR server password from STServer.ini and uses this PC as the UDP relay host.
